text: Status: SX is working on the engine (pregame fair odds, all leagues, no errors). I have NOT built the live lane yet, and I won't claim otherwise. Plan, written to TASKS.md (TCL111f1): (1) have the engine record real SX live frames first, because the live-odds/score format has only been read from docs, never from your key; (2) then an SX live feed plugged into the existing live lane (same as the Bolt one: live scores trigger, 5 s freshness rule); (3) paper-only until paper results exist, real orders behind their own default-off switch; (4) engine parity. Step 1 is next.
